build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone from a Detectron2 config with configurable depth, norm, and deformable conv options
create_basicblock: create a BasicBlock residual layer with two 3x3 convolutions for ResNet-18 or ResNet-34
create_bottleneckblock: create a BottleneckBlock residual layer with 1x1, 3x3, 1x1 convolutions for ResNet-50 and deeper
create_deformbottleneckblock: create a DeformBottleneckBlock with deformable convolution in the 3x3 layer for improved spatial modeling
create_resnet_stage: create a ResNet stage by calling ResNet.make_stage with a block class, number of blocks, and channel config
